d: A US military aircraft has transmitted a 7700 general emergency signal over Israel after a reported sharp drop in speed and altitude. Meanwhile, Iran claims that oil tankers caught fire after striking mines in the Strait of Hormuz, as another maritime incident involving explosive devices raises concerns about commercial shipping security. Is West Asia heading towards another major military escalation?
